en.summary: Generation with audio or mixed references works again.
changes: Image plus audio and other mixed-reference requests no longer fail while downloading reference resources; the default 8-step schedule uses small published tables instead of the original projection weights.
Reference resources follow your download source and connection settings, and resume after an interruption.

zh.summary: 修复音频及混合参考无法生成的问题。
changes: 修复图片加音频等混合参考在下载参考资源时失败的问题；默认 8 步改用已发布的小型调制表，不再下载原始投影权重。
参考资源按所选下载源和网络设置下载，中断后可继续。
下载参考资源时显示进度。
